alt.en: U-shaped kitchen seen through a white framed opening, with white panel cabinets, built-in hob and oven

caption.tr: Geniş söveli bir açıklığın ardında, beyaz boyalı çerçeveli kapaklarla yapılmış U planlı mutfak. Dolaplar ve söve aynı beyaz tonda.
caption.en: A U-shaped kitchen behind a wide moulded opening, with white painted panel doors. The cabinets and door casing share the same white finish.
